fullDescription: A full NONPROFIT / ADVOCACY CAMPAIGN LANDING PAGE whose point of view is a published ordering rule shown operating: the organization prints the exact rule by which it takes cases, and the waiting list underneath visibly obeys it, every row carrying the fields that placed it plus one sentence of why. Flat hot MAGENTA `#f42fcb` ground, near-black `#160a2b` ink and filled row slabs, one inverted near-black band, no gradients and no glow anywhere. Bold grotesque headings against a serif body, left-anchored and asymmetric, composed with hairline rules. Reusable for any campaign, union, legal-aid, charity or community-organizing site, and the annotated ranked-row pattern lifts straight onto a waitlist, a moderation queue, support triage or admissions.

structured.summary: A complete NONPROFIT / ADVOCACY CAMPAIGN LANDING PAGE for an invented tenants' union, built so its whole personality is ONE decision made auditable: the organization PUBLISHES the exact rule by which it takes cases, and the live waiting list on the page visibly OBEYS that rule. Flat hot MAGENTA ground (#f42fcb) everywhere, near-black ink (#160a2b) used both as the type colour and as six filled row slabs, one inverted near-black band (#0b0518), muted purple hairlines (#5b2e8c), white type inside the dark slabs. No gradients, no glow, no box-shadow, no dot-grid or line-grid texture, no photography. Type is a strict two-face split: a bold grotesque (Darker Grotesque 800) for every heading, statement and numeral, and a serif (Source Serif 4) for every supporting paragraph, all sentence case with at most two uppercase letter-spaced labels on the entire page. Left-anchored and asymmetric throughout, composed by generous whitespace and full-width 1px hairline rules, never centered symmetry. Top to bottom: (1) a thin masthead, two-line wordmark far left, four small links right, one solid near-black pill 'Join the union'; (2) THE FIRST SCREEN IS THE LIST ITSELF, not a hero about the cause: a small dateline, then the rule set at hero scale in the grotesque, a one-line serif promise, a plain join button, a sentence-case column header row, then six equal-height filled near-black slabs each carrying a large magenta position numeral, a case ref, a hearing date, a children yes/no, a days-waiting figure, and one plain sentence saying why it sits there, with the two rows where the rule COSTS someone their place set in magenta as the proof it bites; (3) a line under the list stating that no single column produces that order; (4) a hairline, then a 'How we decide' section as one large statement left and a 2x2 text-only principle grid right; (5) one INVERTED near-black band for the three services; (6) three closed cases as plain hairline-separated lines with qualitative outcomes only; (7) a Join section, three numbered steps left and a filled near-black panel right carrying the dues line and a large magenta button; (8) a hairline and a quiet footer. NOTHING on the page is drawn to scale: every row is the same height regardless of its dates or wait, because the rule is an ORDER and not a quantity, so there are no bars, no proportional columns, no timeline, no axis and no scale key.

style.description: A campaign-poster register built on total value contrast rather than decoration: a single saturated hot-magenta field carrying near-black filled slabs, with flat colour only and not one gradient, glow, shadow or texture on the page. The personality comes from three things: the committed magenta ground, the grotesque-versus-serif split, and the fact that the biggest type on the page is a procedural rule rather than a slogan. Deliberately against the generated default for this category, which is a soft documentary photo hero, warm earth tones, a rounded sans and a gradient donate button. Sentence case throughout; uppercase letter-spaced labels rationed to two on the whole page so it never fingerprints as a template.
style.prompt: Design a full NONPROFIT / ADVOCACY CAMPAIGN landing page for an invented tenants' union, generically branded (invent the organization, the case references, the addresses; never reuse a real charity, union or address). Put the ENTIRE page on a flat hot MAGENTA ground #f42fcb. Use near-black #160a2b as both the ink and as solid filled slabs, one darker near-black #0b0518 for a single inverted band, muted purple #5b2e8c for hairline rules only, and white for type inside the dark slabs. Absolutely no gradients, no glow, no box-shadow, no text-shadow, no dot-grid or line-grid background texture, no photography, no icons. Type is a strict two-face split: 'Darker Grotesque' weight 800 for every heading, statement and numeral, 'Source Serif 4' for every supporting paragraph. Sentence case everywhere; at most TWO uppercase letter-spaced labels on the whole page. Keep everything left-anchored and asymmetric, composed by generous whitespace and full-width 1px hairline rules, never centered symmetry. It must read like a real campaign built by people who care about being fair, not like a charity template.

layout_and_structure.description: A full landing page that scrolls, opening ON the mechanism rather than on a hero about the cause. Masthead, then the published rule and the ranked list as the first screen, then a hairline, a principles section, one inverted band of services, a closed-cases list, a Join section, a hairline and a footer. Responsive: at 390px the queue rows collapse to stacked label and value pairs while keeping exactly the same order, and nothing overflows horizontally at any width.

prompts.prompt: A thin top bar: a two-line bold grotesque wordmark far left; on the right four small links (The queue / How we decide / What we do / Join) and one solid near-black #160a2b rounded pill button 'Join the union' with magenta #f42fcb text. No headline of any kind in this masthead and no logo row.

prompts.part: The published rule as the first screen
prompts.partPt: The published rule as the first screen
prompts.prompt: Do NOT open with a hero about the cause. Open with a small dateline in uppercase letter-spaced caps ('Queue published 07:00, Thursday 31 July'), then the ordering rule itself set at hero scale in the grotesque at weight 800 with leading around 0.95 ('Soonest hearing first. Then households with children. Then longest wait.'), then one serif line stating the promise ('Published every morning at 07:00, and we do not move anyone up it.'), then a plain solid near-black join pill. The biggest type on the page is the rule, not a slogan.

Below the rule, a sentence-case column header row (Ref / Hearing / Children / Waiting / Why it sits here) in the grotesque, then six rows. Each row is a SOLID FILLED #160a2b slab on the magenta ground with generous padding, carrying a large magenta position numeral at the left, then the four field values in the serif in white, then one plain sentence saying why the row sits where it does. EVERY ROW IS THE SAME HEIGHT: nothing is proportional, no bars, no timeline, no axis, no scale key, no hatched lane. Order the rows so the rule visibly does work the columns cannot: the row with the LONGEST wait on the list must sit second because it has no children on a tied hearing date, and one row must sit behind two shorter waits because those households have children. Set the why-sentence on those two rows in magenta so they read as the proof the rule bites. Under the list, one grotesque line: 'No single column on this list produces that order. That is the rule doing the work.' Make sure that claim is actually TRUE of your six rows.

After a full-width hairline, a section with one uppercase letter-spaced label, one large grotesque statement in the left third, and a 2x2 grid of text-only principle blocks in the right two thirds, each a grotesque subhead plus a serif paragraph. No cards, no borders, no icons. The four principles restate the rule as commitments: published before the day starts, nobody buys their way up, a hearing date outranks a wait, children outrank everything except a hearing date.

One full-bleed band on the darker near-black #0b0518 with white type: a large grotesque section heading in the left third and three text blocks across the right two thirds, each a grotesque subhead plus a serif paragraph. This band exists to spread the page's value range, so keep it clean, with no icons and no decorative marks.

Back on magenta: a grotesque heading and three plain hairline-separated lines, each a case reference, a date, and a one-clause outcome. Qualitative outcomes only. NO aggregate statistics, no percentages, no member counts, no testimonials, no logos.

The ask: a grotesque heading and three short numbered steps in the serif on the left; on the right a FILLED near-black #160a2b panel carrying the dues line set large in the grotesque, a full-width magenta #f42fcb button with near-black text at real size, and one small serif line about the intake cutoff. Keep the primary action a plain, high-contrast, ordinary-place affordance: never draw it inside the ranked list.

A full-width hairline, then a quiet footer: the two-line wordmark and a street address on the left, the same four links in two columns in the middle, and the queue's publish time repeated once on the right. Keep every fact consistent with the rest of the page: one locale, one currency mentioned once, one set of dates.

special_ui_components.description: The whole point of view in one component: a filled near-black slab carrying a large magenta position numeral, the fields that determined the placement, and one plain sentence of why it sits there. Equal height for every row, because the rule is an order and not a quantity.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build a queue row as a solid #160a2b slab on the magenta ground with padding around 32px. Left: the position number in the grotesque at weight 800, roughly 60px, in magenta #f42fcb, in a fixed-width column. Middle: a four-column grid of the fields that decided the placement, each value in the serif in white, with its label shown only on mobile. Right: about two fifths of the width for one plain serif sentence explaining why the row sits here. Every row must be the SAME height whatever its values. On the rows where the rule costs someone their place, set that sentence in magenta so it reads as the proof the rule is real. At 390px collapse the row to stacked label and value pairs and keep the order identical.

special_ui_components.description: The procedural rule itself, set at hero scale, replacing the headline that would normally describe the cause.
special_ui_components.prompt: Set the ordering rule verbatim as the page's largest type: grotesque weight 800, clamped roughly 40px to 90px, leading about 0.95, tight tracking, left-aligned, max width around four fifths of the column. Underneath it one serif line at about 24px stating the promise, then a plain solid near-black pill. Never wrap this in a gradient band, a glow, a centered layout or a decorative pill row.

special_ui_components.description: One header row above the list instead of repeating field labels inside every row, which is what makes a table read as a template.
special_ui_components.prompt: Above the first row, lay a header rail matching the row grid exactly: a spacer the width of the position numeral, then the four field names, then the why column. Set them in the grotesque at semibold, small, SENTENCE CASE, in the ink on the magenta ground. Hide this rail below the medium breakpoint and show the per-row labels there instead, so labels never appear twice at any width.

special_ui_components.description: The ask, given real weight: a near-black panel carrying the dues line and a large magenta button.
special_ui_components.prompt: Build the right half of the Join section as a filled #160a2b panel with padding around 40px: the dues line set large in the grotesque in white, then a full-width rounded button in magenta #f42fcb with near-black text at about 24px, then one small serif line about the intake cutoff at reduced opacity. This is the page's primary conversion moment, so let it be the most resolved block below the list.

special_ui_components.description: A single full-bleed near-black band that widens the page's value range so a saturated single-hue ground never reads as flat.
special_ui_components.prompt: Make one section full-bleed on #0b0518 with white type and no other colour except, if needed, small magenta marks. Place it roughly two thirds down the page. Keep it free of icons and decorative shapes: the value change is the effect.
